title: DEAG lifts nine-month revenue while EBITDA falls 27%
summary: German promoter DEAG has reported a 4.3% year-on-year increase in revenue to €336.8m for the first nine months of 2026, although EBITDA fell by 27% to €13.8m in the same period. The decline compares this EBITDA number for January to September 2026 with €18.8m for the same period in 2025, a reduction of €5m. Despite this, the German live entertainment group said it remained on track to meet its full-year guidance. title: Global Concerts GmbH to take over programming for Munich’s Tollwood Summer Festival
summary: DEAG-subsidiary promoter Global Concerts is to take over programming for Munich’s Tollwood Summer Festival from 2028, as well as management responsibilities for the Olympiapark Music Arena venue. The festival centres around concerts at its Tollwood Music Arena site, a 6,000-cap outdoor venue, which will now be led by Global Concerts managing director Andrea Blahetek-Hauzenberger. This venue management switch precedes Global Concerts’ takeover of programming for the wider festival, which will begin in 2028. title: City Focus: Kuala Lumpur
summary: Powered by government support, regional connectivity, and a run of recent blockbuster on-sales, Kuala Lumpur is in the middle of its most ambitious live music expansion yet.
